description: Delete a scrape job and its run history. This cannot be undone: update_scrape_job with enabled false pauses it instead. Hosted scraping is behind a release flag: until it is on for your workspace this answers 501 hosted_scraping_not_enabled. Runs honour robots.txt and fetch only public https pages. Needs a Last Price credential with the commerce:configure scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

job_id.description: The scrape job UUID: id on a list_scrape_jobs result.

name: delete_scrape_job
